text: SK Hynix reported second-quarter revenue of 79.32 trillion won and operating profit of 60.54 trillion won, both substantially above the prior year but below market expectations. Shares closed 9.6% lower after falling as much as 15% intraday. The company reported record first-half revenue, expanded HBM4 shipments, and maintained investment plans.

meta.note: Operating performance and equity valuation occupy different observed structural states within the same event.

text: Brent crude futures rose 7.2% to $90.12 per barrel and West Texas Intermediate futures gained 6.6% to $84.46. U.S. and Iran military activity remained active, while attacks involving oil infrastructure, maritime transit, and regional export routes were reported across the Middle East.

meta.note: Military reports and commodity pricing coexist without establishing directional causation.

text: The Federal Open Market Committee voted 9-3 to maintain the federal funds target range at 3.50%-3.75%. Three regional Federal Reserve presidents dissented in favor of a 25-basis-point increase, while the majority maintained the existing target range. The decision preserved the current policy rate under a recorded split vote.

meta.note: The unchanged policy rate and recorded dissent represent distinct structural states within one decision.

text: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield rose to 5.201%, reaching an intraday high of 5.244%, its highest level since 2007. The 10-year yield increased to 4.671%, while the 2-year yield declined to 4.236%. The federal funds target range remained unchanged at 3.50%-3.75%.

meta.note: Yield movements differed across maturities while the policy rate remained unchanged.

text: Starbucks reported adjusted earnings per share of $0.85 on revenue of $9.32 billion and recorded a fourth consecutive quarter of same-store sales growth. The company raised its fiscal 2026 adjusted earnings and comparable sales outlook. Shares rose as much as 9% in extended trading following the release.

meta.note: Revenue declined due to the China transaction while comparable operating metrics increased.

text: Chipotle reported adjusted earnings per share of $0.33 on revenue of $3.35 billion. Comparable restaurant sales increased 2.2%, supported by higher transaction volume and average check. The company raised its full-year comparable sales outlook from flat growth to low single-digit growth while noting late-July sales effects associated with the cyclospora outbreak.

meta.note: Food safety reporting and operating performance coexist without establishing attribution.

text: Meta reported revenue of $60.80 billion and earnings per share of $6.18 while issuing quarterly revenue guidance below market expectations. Annual capital expenditure guidance narrowed to $130-145 billion. Free cash flow declined to $784 million from $8.55 billion a year earlier, and shares fell in extended trading.

meta.note: Operating revenue, investment levels, and cash generation reflect different financial dimensions within one reporting period.

text: Microsoft reported quarterly revenue of $90.01 billion and adjusted earnings above market expectations. Azure revenue exceeded $100 billion for the fiscal year, growing 41%, while quarterly capital expenditures and finance leases increased 69% to $41 billion. Free cash flow declined 23%, and the company reaffirmed elevated capital investment plans.

meta.note: Revenue growth, investment expansion, and cash generation represent separate financial measures within the same reporting period.

text: U.S. forces resumed strikes against Iranian targets after previously halting operations. U.S. Central Command identified the strikes as a response to recent missile attacks on American forces. Military operations involving U.S., Iranian, and regional forces remained active, while disruption affecting the Strait of Hormuz persisted.

meta.note: Military operations resumed after a pause, but the underlying contest remained active.

text: The Senate Judiciary Committe postponed its scheduled vote on the nomination of Todd Blanche for U.S. attorney general. Advancement from committee remained pending as additional written assurances were requested by committee members regarding provisions of a Department of Justice settlement. The nomination remained before the committee without a recorded vote.

meta.note: Committee postponement preserved nomination status while committee support remained unresolved.
